name: De Cecco Stelline Pastina (Tender Tiny Star Pasta)
whyItWorks: The quintessential Italian gut-healing comfort food. Tiny star pasta cooked directly in homemade chicken bone broth until creamy and tender. Requires virtually zero digestive breakdown.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer 1/3 cup stelline in 1.5 cups salted chicken bone broth for 6–7 minutes until broth is absorbed and pasta is velvety soft.
